subject: Pricing & commitment timing map for NovumTech order
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novumtech.it>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novumtech.it
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Re: preliminary commercial questions for Redwood order

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the call earlier — quick follow up from procurement. Before we circulate the order form to legal, they need a clear map of the commercial timing so they can feed it into our cashflow planning. Specifically:

- How will the minimum commit be invoiced (monthly in arrears, quarterly upfront, or a hybrid)?
- If we do staged invoicing tied to usage tranches, what are the dates/percentages?
- Which entity issues the invoice and where will VAT be applied (we're Italy-based) — we need the tax residency statement attached.
- Any standard Net terms you can offer for EU customers (Net 30 / Net 45)?

Can you send a short timing/amount map and an annotated order form so our Sourcing and Legal teams can redline? We prefer a single PDF with callouts.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement | NovumTech
--
NovumTech SRL
Via Roma 12, Milan

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novumtech.it>, procurement@novumtech.it
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: preliminary commercial questions for Redwood order

Elena — thanks, this is helpful. Attaching a concise timing map and a draft order form with our commercial defaults called out. High level answers below and in the PDF callouts: 

- Minimum commit invoicing: Default is quarterly invoicing in arrears for consumed tokens with an upfront first invoice that covers the first 30 days of committed capacity when a commit includes reserved capacity. If you prefer monthly in arrears we can support that but it requires Finance sign-off for Net 30.

- Staged invoicing: We support tranche-based invoicing for multi-quarter commitments (example in PDF: 40% at signing / 30% at Q2 start / 30% at Q4 start). We can mirror NovumTech's fiscal quarters — see callouts.

- Invoice entity & VAT: Redwood UK Ltd will issue the invoice for EU customers by default; VAT treatment depends on whether you provide a valid EU VAT ID. If NovumTech provides tax residency evidence (attached), we will zero-rate intercompany VAT per EU reverse-charge rules when applicable. Our tax team will confirm after reviewing your certificate.

- Net terms: Standard offering is Net 30 for self-serve customers; for committed contracts we typically offer Net 45 on approval (requires finance-approval and credit checks). For initial procurement we can tentatively offer Net 45 pending completed credit paperwork.

Next steps I suggest:
1) We attach the annotated Order Form PDF (NovumTech_Order_Form_DRAFT.pdf).
2) You share any redlines from Legal (we'll prepare a tracked response).
3) If procurement prefers a different invoicing cadence, flag which cadence and we will run to Finance for a non-standard terms approval.

I've attached: NovumTech_Order_Form_DRAFT.pdf (commercial callouts) and NovumTech_Tax_Residency_Statement.pdf (example format).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, EMEA | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novumtech.it>, procurement@novumtech.it
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: preliminary commercial questions for Redwood order

Elena — adding a couple of notes from Legal/Finance after a quick internal sync. We put the detailed redlines into OF_redlines_karthik_20260804.docx (attached). Points to call out: 

- "Billing cadence": Legal prefers the template language to describe "billing in arrears" and to include a catch-all that final usage reconciliations happen within 45 days of invoice. Finance wants the initial invoice to be payable within 30 days of receipt if it's for committed capacity; otherwise Net 45 for consumption-only line items is OK.

- "VAT handling": We'll include a clause that states Redwood will apply reverse-charge where NovumTech provides a valid VAT registration. If no VAT ID is provided, Redwood will apply local VAT at invoice date. Please confirm your VAT number so we can pre-populate invoices.

- "Proration and credits": For phased starts, we propose pro-rating the first invoice to reflect actual activation date (example calculations in the Docx).

- "Escrow/withholding": If your AP team requires an escrow clause or a payment holdback for acceptance milestones, specify the exact percentage and milestone date so we can route to Finance.

We want to avoid multiple back-and-forths: if you can get Legal's redlines into the attached docx with highlights, Ben will triage commercial asks and I will coordinate the legal responses. 

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Contracts & Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novumtech.it>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novumtech.it, accounts.payable@novumtech.it
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 15:04:00 +0200
Subject: Re: preliminary commercial questions for Redwood order

Thanks Karthik and Kimberly — we reviewed the PDF and the Word redlines. A few quick confirmations from NovumTech side: 

- VAT: NovumTech VAT ID is IT12345678901 — attached you'll find the company's tax residency statement (NovumTech_Tax_Residency_Statement.pdf). Please prepopulate the invoice entity accordingly and revert if you need a different residency document.

- Billing cadence: Procurement prefers monthly in arrears for operational simplicity. Can you confirm whether monthly in arrears will keep Net 45 availability or if that's restricted? If Net 45 can be applied to monthly consumption invoices we can proceed that way.

- Initial payment: We agree to an initial 30% at signing (invoice due Net 30) followed by monthly consumption invoices for any overage. Please confirm the exact invoice schedule and whether the initial 30% will be credited pro-rata against the first three months of usage.

- Redlines: Legal will upload a single tracked DOCX by EOD Friday. We'll flag any non-standard escrow/withholding asks there.

If you can produce an updated order form with the billing cadence set to monthly in arrears plus a Net 45 payment term option (subject to credit approval), we can push this to Legal next week.

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement | NovumTech
